av2.what: AV2 is on: xrdp sends it to the clients that offer it (the kit's FreeRDP clients and FreeRDP Web), AV1 to the others. To put AV1 first again
av2.command: sudo sed -i 's/^order = \[ "AV2", "AV1"/order = [ "AV1"/' /etc/xrdp/gfx.toml && sudo systemctl restart xrdp

windows.command: Invoke-WebRequest https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261101.1/freerdp-host-20261031.8-windows-x86_64.zip -OutFile freerdp-host.zip; Expand-Archive freerdp-host.zip; Set-Location freerdp-host\freerdp-host-*; .\freerdp-shadow-service.exe install --allow-sas -- /bind-address:127.0.0.1 /gfx-av1 /gfx-av2
